03 · I LEHKHA TE I HNENAH A AWM
I lehkha te i dawrah a awm.
Hralh, mi leh ni lehkha te chu i zuar dawhkan hmanruaah ziak a ni — i hlawh server-ah a ni lo.
Hralh, pek leh docket tin i computer emaw tablet ngeiah dah ṭha a ni.
Kan hnenah akaunt a ngai lo
Install la ṭan rawh. Sign-up a ngai lo, card a ngai lo.
I duh hunah backup copy dah ṭha rawh. File a ni a, i ta a ni.
Zuar dawhkan leh tablet belh te i Wi-Fi ngeiin an inzawm — a inkarah internet a ngai lo.
Kumkaj app te hian hna thawk turin server an be ngai lo. Internet tikhawlo la, zuar dawhkanah eng nge danglam en rawh.

Bil emaw docket dah ṭha rawh

Dawr pawna kal thil, entirnan WhatsApp receipt, chu thleng turin internet a la mamawh.
I hmanruaah chatuanin a man lovin.
Ṭhutna, hmangtu, dawhkan, hlantu, bawm emaw local hmanrua tin man a awm lo. Enchhinna a ni lo.
I hman chauh pe rawh — mi zawng zawng tan man ang chiah.
Cloud chu ruahman mek a ni a, i duh chuan. Zuar dawhkan chu a tel lovin a thawk.

App te ang chiah ziak siamna engine, chuvangin hawrawp inzawm leh ding lam aṭanga vei lama ziak tlar te a dik.

Courier · chawfakna · thil chi tin · damdawi
Courier dawhkan — book, hming dahna, hlan, inchhiar fel.
Chawfakna system — dawhkan, buh chhumna, bil, ni khar.
Thil chi tin zuarna dawhkan — hralh, khata, thil khawl, ni lehkha.
Damdawi zuarna dawhkan — batch, a hman theih hun, bil, ni khar.
Internet a thi — mahse zuar dawhkanah engmah a danglam lo.
Kumkaj thil siam tin hian akaunt hrang (leh cloud hrang) an nei. I sumdawnna thlang rawh — luhna leh pawisa pekna chu chu thil siam website-ah a awm.

Kum tin cloud ruahmanna — sumdawnna tin atan chi nga ang chiah (Chatuanin a man lovin, Steady ₹6,000, Swift ₹12,000, Priority ₹24,000 / kum, chhiah tel lovin, emaw duh ang man chhut). Chhiah chu pawisa pekna-ah belh a ni. Thil siam tinin an dawr leh akaunt ngei an nei.
